question: Do the donor entities push an agenda, and can a philosophy be sourced for them?
headline: 0 of 17 entity donors publish a political or philosophical position. None does. The layer is therefore built from documented activity, not from stated intent.
rule: A position is quoted from the entity's own publication, or it is null. Activity is from KvK/SBI or the entity's own site. No motive is inferred from a gift.

entities.name: Stichting Het Thorbeckefonds
entities.activity: VVD fundraising foundation, named after Thorbecke, publishes annual accounts
entities.basis: Media reporting describes it as funding VVD campaigns partly from investment returns.
entities.caveat: Not outside money; a party fundraising vehicle.

entities.name: Stichting Ondersteuning VVD Tweede Kamerverkiezing
entities.basis: Follow the Money party-financing investigation identifies it as one of the VVD's support foundations and reports ~EUR 1.2m to the party in the analysed period.
entities.caveat: Not outside money. Counting this as third-party influence would double-count the party's own campaign financing.

entities.name: Stichting The Dreamery Foundation
entities.basis: Policy plans published at dreamery.org; the substantive mission was not extracted.
entities.caveat: It publishes policy plans, so a position probably EXISTS - it simply has not been read. This is the one entity where reading the document would move it out of no-claim.

entities.name: Stichting Ivo Opstelten Foundation
entities.activity: VVD-linked support foundation (KvK 27342104), ANBI, has its own VVD-hosted page
entities.basis: Own annual report and ANBI filing published via vvd.nl.
entities.caveat: Not outside money. NRC reported in 2017 that the VVD broke tax law with the foundation; no enforcement decision was found.

entities.name: Keurvorst B.V.
entities.basis: SBI holdings (non-financial); subsidiary activity not established.
entities.caveat: Subsidiaries unestablished, so the money's domain is unknown.

entities.name: Movet Beheer B.V.
entities.activity: Holding / management entity, Loenen aan de Vecht (KvK 33299469)
entities.basis: Registry only. Several same-named B.V.s exist, so even the KvK match is unconfirmed.
entities.caveat: Identity caveat: the donor entity's KvK cannot be confirmed from free sources.

entities.name: Chipshol 2000 B.V.
entities.activity: Land development around Schiphol; ~100 lawsuits against the state, Schiphol and LVNL since 1993
entities.subject: luchtvaart en ruimtelijke ordening rond Schiphol
entities.basis: The entity's litigation IS its published position: it claims the state and Schiphol unlawfully blocked its development. Gerechtshof Arnhem-Leeuwarden, 25 March 2025, held the Rechtbank Den Haag acted unlawfully and partially 1994-1998. Claims reported at up to EUR 6bn.
entities.caveat: A litigation position is a documented interest, not a policy programme. No published statement on party policy was found.

entities.name: Trigona Dairy Trade B.V.
entities.activity: Dairy and non-dairy commodity trading for industry, foodservice and retail (KvK 30130720)
entities.subject: zuivel en landbouwmarktordening
entities.basis: Company's own about page: dairy commodity trading, GMP-FSA, SKAL (BIO) and BRC certified.
entities.caveat: Operating in the funded party's core policy domain. The direction of interest - more or less regulation, more or less nitrogen space - is not published and is not inferred.

entities.name: Sensemakers BV
entities.activity: ICT / internet services / web portals; operates AS47121
entities.subject: internet en digitale infrastructuur
entities.basis: SBI web portals and a public ASN allocation.
entities.caveat: No informative website content retrieved; sector is from SBI and the ASN record.

entities.name: Mega Management B.V.
entities.basis: SBI financial holdings. Insolvency 2026, rechtbank Limburg F.03/26/254.
entities.caveat: No published activity, so no domain and no claim. Note the donation predates the insolvency.

entities.name: Ka Ve Invest B.V.
entities.basis: SBI financial holdings; no underlying activity published.
entities.caveat: A holding at a Schiphol address is not evidence of a Schiphol interest. No claim drawn.

entities.name: Lambda Furtherance B.V.
entities.activity: Wholesale of other building materials (KvK 27265414); supplies PANACEA polyacrylonitrile fibre
entities.subject: bouw en bouwmaterialen
entities.basis: SBI registration plus the company's own product site.
entities.caveat: Sector from SBI and product line only. No position published.

entities.name: Sjopperdepop BV
entities.activity: Wholesale of household, office and shop furniture (Haarlem)
entities.subject: retail en meubelgroothandel
entities.caveat: Sector from SBI only. The company's own about page could not be read.

entities.name: Stichting Dona
entities.activity: Duurzame Ontwikkeling Nederland Afrika (KvK 41158157), ANBI development foundation
entities.subject: ontwikkelingssamenwerking
entities.basis: The foundation's own objectives page and ANBI page.
entities.caveat: A development foundation funding a party that wants lower development spending is a tension worth quoting both sides of, not resolving here.

entities.name: Ozephius Group B.V.
entities.activity: Holding company (KvK 24213791); related entity Ozephius Stainless B.V., metal processing
entities.subject: metaal en industrie
entities.basis: Registry entries for the holding and for Ozephius Stainless B.V.
entities.caveat: The holding itself does nothing public; the sector is inferred from a related entity, which is a weaker basis than a direct SBI code.

entities.name: Op de Mast B.V.
entities.basis: No SBI description, website or business description retrievable.
entities.caveat: Nothing found is not nothing exists. Recorded as unknown.

entities.name: Graansloot Kampen B.V.
entities.activity: Inland terminal: transshipment, storage and processing of grain, oilseeds and feedstocks
entities.subject: agrologistiek en grondstoffen
entities.basis: Company's own pages: dry bulk transshipment and storage, GMP+ FSA, EU Organic, AEO certified.
entities.caveat: Same limit as Trigona: the domain is documented, the direction is not.
